metadata.purpose: Route source values through live multicast windows closed by supplied scheduler events or per-window counts.

conditions: One initial handle; sequential mode starts a new window whenever the previous window closes.
Periodic mode opens independently on creation ticks; windows overlap, abut or leave gaps according to span and interval.
Source next goes to each current window and can close it at maxSize; the closing value never enters its sequential successor.
Source terminals reach windows before the outer observer; outer cancellation leaves open child Subjects silent and uncompleted.

scope.parameters: Positive safe-integer span, interval and finite maxSize in 1..1000. Null interval selects restart-on-close; null maxSize is unbounded. Finite safe-integer supplied scheduler time and counters without overflow.
scope.callbacks: No user function is invoked. Opaque source values retain identity. Emitted tokens denote Observable handles, not collected arrays.
scope.time: Deferred FIFO scheduler profile. Inputs carry supplied now; runWindowTimeTrace enforces now equals trace-envelope time. Explicit timer identities/ticks and input order decide same-time reactions. Delayed timer delivery is admissible at or after its due time.
scope.reentrancy: Atomic non-reentrant reactions. Consumers attach between reactions; callbacks that subscribe, cancel or emit during a current reaction are characterized separately if tested.
exclusions: Zero/negative/fractional/non-finite durations, invalid overload normalization and synchronous scheduler execution.
Setup-time source delivery, arbitrary reentrancy, subject implementation mutation and clock/counter overflow.
Scheduler-specific physical Action allocation; recurring creation is normalized to one logical timer with explicit firing ticks.
Throwing observer/producer teardown, arbitrary reentrancy and universal infinite-trace liveness are not modeled.

initialization.sourceSubscription: Optional creation timer, initial handle, its close timer, then source acquisition. No synchronous source delivery or clock advancement during setup.

ownership.sharing: Each outer execution owns independent source/timer resources. Each inner window is live multicast without replay; consumers hold no upstream lease.
ownership.reset: Create fresh bookkeeping for each result connection. Payload objects are not cloned.

resources.owner: window record; generation is window identity

dispatch.actionSemantics: Ordered action words are model predictions, not executed effects. Callback invocation IDs correlate outcomes; they are not subscription IDs.
cancellationCheckpoints: Between external reactions. Cancellation during synchronous multi-action delivery is characterized separately, not silently admitted into this profile.

inputs.description: First connection to this result execution.
A value from the currently owned source subscription.
Source failure with an opaque error value.
Consumer closes the result connection silently.
Current window close timer delivers its generation at or after its deadline.
The configured recurring creation task delivers its current firing tick.
Fresh observer attaches to an emitted current or historical window.
One child observer closes its independent connection.

controls.description: See the typed state and named transitions for Active.
Outer stopped; completed/failed historical handles and orphan child subscriptions remain observable.

sources.purpose: Upstream scenario basis; test bodies inspected, not claimed to have been executed as the upstream suite.

rules.guard: first connection; safe supplied scheduler time
rules.nextState: One empty window is live; its deadline is now + span.
rules.explanation: Construction is inert. Periodic creation is scheduled before the initial window; window handle and close timer precede source acquisition.

rules.guard: source is live; counts and possible new window identity remain safe
actions: for each current window in order: deliver source value
complete and cancel any window reaching maxSize
restart immediately only in sequential mode
rules.nextState: Per-window counts advance; a restarted window does not receive the value that closed its predecessor.
rules.explanation: RxJS snapshots its active record list, then delivers and closes one record at a time. Overlapping windows can therefore see another window complete before receiving the same value.

rules.guard: current live window timer generation; now is at or after its deadline
actions: restart and schedule successor only in sequential mode
rules.nextState: The specified window completes without replay; historical completed handles remain usable.
rules.explanation: A deadline is data, not an automatic transition. Old generations and early timer delivery are rejected.

actions: terminate every active window in creation order
rules.nextState: All current handles remember the source terminal; historical completed handles retain completion.
rules.explanation: Inner terminals precede the outer terminal. Cleanup follows registration: creation timer, initial-window timer if still live, source, then later-window timers.

actions: terminate every active window in creation order
rules.nextState: All current handles remember the source terminal; historical completed handles retain completion.
rules.explanation: Inner terminals precede the outer terminal. Cleanup follows registration: creation timer, initial-window timer if still live, source, then later-window timers.

actions: release timers and source in registration order without notifications
rules.nextState: Open window Subjects and their child subscriptions become silent orphans; historical handles remain usable.
rules.explanation: windowTime clears its record registry on disposal but does not complete or unsubscribe the Subjects. Child connections hold no upstream lease.

rules.guard: fresh observer identity names an open window
actions: acquire independent window observer without replay
rules.nextState: Observer joins the addressed multicast Subject, including a silent orphan after outer cancellation.
rules.explanation: Attaching a child never creates or retains a source/timer connection.

rules.guard: fresh observer identity names a completed window
rules.nextState: Observer identity is recorded but no live child subscription remains.
rules.explanation: A completed Subject remembers its terminal notification without replaying source values.

actions: release only the addressed child observer
rules.nextState: Other consumers, source ownership and timer ownership do not change.
rules.explanation: Orphaned child subscriptions can be disposed independently after the outer execution stops.

rules.guard: fresh observer identity names an open window
actions: acquire independent window observer without replay
rules.nextState: Observer joins the addressed multicast Subject, including a silent orphan after outer cancellation.
rules.explanation: Attaching a child never creates or retains a source/timer connection.

rules.guard: fresh observer identity names a completed window
rules.nextState: Observer identity is recorded but no live child subscription remains.
rules.explanation: A completed Subject remembers its terminal notification without replaying source values.

actions: release only the addressed child observer
rules.nextState: Other consumers, source ownership and timer ownership do not change.
rules.explanation: Orphaned child subscriptions can be disposed independently after the outer execution stops.

rules.guard: fresh observer names a window failed by the source
rules.nextState: Failed handle remains failed; no source values are replayed.
rules.explanation: Error retention differs from both historical completion and silent orphaning on cancellation.
